patterns.message: getSupabaseAdmin() is the service-role client and BYPASSES RLS — importing it in a referrer route defeats cross-tenant isolation. Referrer routes must obtain their DB client from lib/referrals/referrer-context.ts (the JWT-bound anon client). Admin routes live under app/partners/admin/** and are excluded from this rule. See docs/partners/00-referral-portal-plan.md §3.
